messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — Jin Park is starting THU (48h). Background check flagged an SSN/last-name mismatch (Smith vs Park) and he's traveling in. He requested an ASL interpreter for day 1 and needs same-day I-9 completion. Can we do on-site notary + interpreter 8–10am? cc: @it-support @marta @legal.ops :thinking_face:

marta: I can arrange ASL for 8–10am. I'll book interpreter vendor and reserve expense code. Do we want the interpreter to join the orientation call or just in-person for I-9?

it-support: Laptop shipping shows delayed (carrier). We can stage a spare laptop + hot desk. Tech pickup window 8–9:30am in Lobby B. We'll pre-provision corp account; please confirm user email.

bg-checks-bot: Background check update for Jin Park (Order #BG-87321): "SSN/name mismatch" — vendor requests scanned court name-change docs or SSA letter. Upload link: https://bg.vendor/portal/ABC123 (expires in 72h).

jin.park: Hi all — thanks for the ping. I'll fly in Wed night and can be on-site 8am THU. I have passport (Park), original court order for name change, and a SSA letter showing updated name. I'll bring originals for I-9. ASL interpreter is appreciated. Also: dietary — vegan.

legal.ops: Confirmed — court order + passport + SSA letter are acceptable for HR I-9 and BG vendor. Please scan PDF copies into Workday after verification. No remote workaround needed if he's on-site.

sara: Plan: Marta books ASL 8–10am (in-person), People Ops reserves notary 8–9am in Conf C, IT provides laptop for pickup 8–9:30am, Legal will clear docs. Jin — please bring originals and a photocopy we can keep. I'll mark food preference and interpreter in the schedule. React with :thumbsup: if this plan works.

marta: Interpreter booked: vendor confirmation `INT-2026-778`. Vendor notes they can join the 9am intro over Zoom if needed. Cost estimate $150/hr — charge to OPEX-ONBOARD.

it-support: Laptop prepped for `jin.park@redwood.com` and encrypted. Badge access request submitted for Lobby B early pickup. We'll hold device until 10:30am.

bg-checks-bot: Received docs from candidate portal (court order + SSA letter). Running vendor verification — ETA 2h.

jin.park: Got it, thanks. One more Q — can I get the employee handbook PDF before THU? Also do you have a recommended parking lot?

sara: Sent handbook link: https://redwood.company/onboard/handbook.pdf. We'll validate parking — use Visitor Lot C, code "ONBOARD23" at kiosk. See you 8am! :raised_hands:
